name: Marn

lines.text: The steps? The steps have always been the steps. Good grazing, stays green late. You are the first person to walk up them looking at them.
Khet. Not step -- khet. It means the water is held. I do not know why we call them that, we just do.
We lose one a year to the millet and we have always lost one a year to the millet. If you are telling me that is a choice and not a weather, I will need to sit down.

notes: Holds two of the map's answers inside ordinary vocabulary and has never had a reason to examine either. The counterpart to Thrali, and pointedly not a wise elder -- he is a working herder with a job on.
